resources.string: Connect letters. Discover words.\nGrow your vocabulary — and your garden.
OFFLINE PLAY · NO ADS · NO ACCOUNT
Make a little time for you
Swipe to connect. Tap to take your time. Every word is a small discovery.
Push-to-talk may use your device’s online speech service. Nothing is recorded by WordBloom.
Six gardens. A world of words.
Complete journey puzzles to open the next. Every four journey puzzles restore a chapter.
Both English editions use the same 24 curated puzzles. More languages are in preparation and require linguistic review.
Try: “shuffle letters”, “give me a hint”, “repeat the word”, “show my progress”, “open daily challenge”, “go home”.

No account. No ads. No analytics. Progress and settings stay on this device. WordBloom stores no microphone recordings. Amazon handles purchase information. Removing the app clears local progress; purchases can be restored through Amazon.

All six illustrated worlds. All 24 curated English puzzles. Advanced and expert challenges. Expanded garden statistics, plus 4 earned hints per first completion instead of 3. Garden milestones and saved daily history.
One-time purchase · No ads · No subscription
New language packs are not currently included. Daily puzzles and the introductory chapter remain free.
